fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Archive documents every night. Needs at least one enabled storage target.

fields.label: Minimum Age (Hours)
fields.description: Documents are archived only after this many hours without changes.

fields.label: Successor From Date
fields.description: Documents dated on or after this day belong to the successor company.

fields.label: Default Upload Type
fields.description: Preselected in the upload dialog until the user has filed a document.

fields.label: Manager Roles
fields.description: Roles that may file and read documents, in addition to Document Manager.

fields.label: Allowed File Types
fields.default:
pdf
png
jpg
jpeg
tif
tiff
xml
fields.description: One file extension per line. Only these file types can be filed.

fields.label: Store E-Invoice XML as Attachment
fields.description: Also store the XML embedded in a ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF as an attachment of the document. The PDF itself is always archived unchanged.

fields.label: Max. Days in the Future
fields.description: A document date may be at most this many days after today.

fields.label: Max. Contract Years
fields.description: A contract end date may be at most this many years after the document date.

fields.label: Storage Targets
fields.description: Every enabled target gets a locked copy of each archived document.

fields.label: E-Mail Accounts
fields.description: Capture and archive business e-mails of these accounts.

fields.label: Mail Write Budget (Seconds)
fields.description: If writing a received mail to the file storage takes longer than this, the next mails are kept in the database for 5 minutes instead. 1 to 30.

fields.label: File later e-mails of a filed thread automatically
Archiving Rule
fields.description: Shown next to the archive action. Empty: default rule.

fields.label: Suggestion Keywords
fields.description: One per line. A mail whose subject contains one of them at the start of a word is suggested for archiving. Empty: default list.

fields.label: Export Part Size (MB)
fields.description: Exports above this size are split into several ZIP files. At most 4096 MB.

fields.label: Keep Exports For (Days)
fields.description: Export files are deleted after this many days.

fields.label: Export Viewer
fields.description: Shown in the offline viewer (index.html) of every export. Leave empty for a neutral viewer.

fields.label: Brand Logo
fields.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, at most 200 KB. It is embedded into the viewer, so nothing loads from the internet.

fields.label: Brand Color
fields.description: Hex color, for example #1a7f37.

fields.label: Lock Audit Log For (Years)
fields.description: Each audit log entry is stored as a locked object on every enabled storage target for this many years.

fields.label: Overdue After (Hours)
fields.description: Archive Admins are notified about documents that are ready but not archived after this many hours. 0 turns the check off.
